annotations.title: AI exposure for a job title

description: Call this when someone asks whether their job is safe from AI, which careers are less exposed, or what AI means for a role, for example "is my job safe from AI" or "how exposed are accountants". Gives how much of a job’s work AI is already used for, from the Anthropic Economic Index, matched from a plain job title. Returns the matched occupation, the exposure share and band, median pay, projected growth, yearly openings, related jobs that pay more or are less exposed, and a link to the full check. It measures observed use now; it is not a forecast of job loss.

title.description: A job title, e.g. "marketing manager" or "accountant".
